set.body:
The module has a fully typed HrfParams enum (Gamma, Gaussian, Spmg, Lwu, Bspline, ...) carried on HrfDescriptor, which is one of its best features. Alongside it survives the untyped predecessor:

- Hrf.params: Map[String, Any]
- HrfParams.Legacy(values: Map[String, Any])
- HrfParams.toLegacyMap

Every Hrf.of / Hrf.scalar / Hrf.multi factory still threads a params: Map[String, Any] argument, defaulting to empty and falling back to descriptor.legacyParams.

External consumers: none. The consumer audit found Hrf.params, HrfDescriptor and HrfParams are used only inside modules/hrf. Downstream code reads Hrf.name and Hrf.nbasis only.

So this is removable without a deprecation cycle. Doing so deletes an Any-typed escape hatch from the public surface of an otherwise carefully typed module.

Context: docs/plans/hrf-hardening.md sections 3.7 and 7.
set.title: Retire HrfParams.Legacy and Hrf.params: Map[String, Any]
